name: ElegantFin TV
description: Minimal ElegantFin design with native Jellyfin motion and Media Bar focus support. Requires a compatible File Transformation plugin. LG C4 integration still requires on-device verification.

versions.changelog: Replace the balanced profile with independent minimal styling: ElegantFin colours, Inter and rounded cards with native Jellyfin layout and motion. Keep the full theme in a separately loaded comparison bundle. TV validation pending.

overview: ElegantFin for webOS and TV layouts
